verdict.rationale: First-party docs say every change to the Model, such as a formula, Table block, or Page edit, is recorded in the Model's changelog under the user's name and can be undone. They also state that every write is undoable, which covers who, what, and rollback. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that changelog entries carry timestamps (the 'when'), in-depth documentation of the changelog and rollback behavior beyond one-line claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
